categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in the general equipment manufacturing industry, with main business segments including: (1) Refrigeration components and products - primarily finned heat exchangers, refrigeration system pipe assemblies, and refrigeration unit modules used in light commercial refrigeration equipment, household refrigeration, air conditioning, and heat pump dryers; (2) Automotive air conditioning system components - including automotive air conditioning pipe systems and pipe fittings for commercial and passenger vehicles; (3) Contract manufacturing services for refrigeration system components. The company has over 2,000 types of finned heat exchanger products with annual production capacity of 8 million units.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company's core technologies are based on heat transfer theory, engineering thermodynamics, refrigeration principles and equipment, and mechanics. Key technologies include: (1) Finned heat exchanger design and manufacturing using tube expansion processes to connect fins with heat exchange tubes; (2) Flexible manufacturing systems capable of multi-variety, small-batch production with rapid mold changeover; (3) Quality control through product quality early planning, failure mode analysis, and statistical process control; (4) Customized design capabilities for different application scenarios. The company holds over 30 core technology patents covering main product categories and production equipment.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The company serves major customers in the light commercial refrigeration equipment industry including: Haier Group, Hisense Group, Midea Group, LG Electronics, Starchi Electric Motor, Aucma, Xingxing Cold Chain, Changan Automobile Group, Carrier, and Envicool. Primary end markets include: light commercial refrigeration equipment (smart retail, commercial kitchens, supermarkets, medical cold chain), household refrigeration equipment, automotive air conditioning systems, heat pump dryers, data centers, and cold chain logistics. In 2023, the top 5 customers accounted for 51.91% of sales revenue.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with headquarters in Xinchang County, Zhejiang Province. It has established subsidiaries and branches in multiple regions including: Tianjin (Tianjin Tongxing Renhe Refrigeration Co., Ltd., Tianjin Hanya Electromechanical Co., Ltd.), Chongqing (Chongqing Tongxing Juchuang Electromechanical Co., Ltd.), Hefei (Hefei Tongxing Refrigeration Co., Ltd.), Jinan (Shandong Tongxing Thermal Energy Technology Co., Ltd.), and Hangzhou (Hangzhou Branch). The company also conducts export business with overseas sales representing 8.38% of 2023 revenue.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates in the midstream to downstream segments of the refrigeration equipment supply chain. It manufactures components and modules that are supplied to downstream original equipment manufacturers (OEMs) of refrigeration equipment, automotive air conditioning systems, and related applications. The company sources raw materials (copper tubes, aluminum tubes, aluminum strips, rubber hoses) from upstream suppliers and sells finished products directly to downstream equipment manufacturers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company's strategic vision is to 'contribute to energy-saving refrigeration systems for human society through green and energy-efficient refrigeration equipment-related products.' Key R&D initiatives include: (1) Development of environmentally-friendly refrigerant products (R290 high-efficiency heat exchangers); (2) High-efficiency, low-carbon heat exchanger manufacturing technology; (3) Expansion into new application areas including data centers, cold chain logistics, and biomedical fields; (4) New energy storage thermal management systems; (5) Smart and intelligent refrigeration products. The company increased R&D personnel by 26% in 2023 and invested 3.67% of revenue in R&D.
categories.revenue_model: The company generates revenue primarily through direct sales of manufactured products. Revenue is recognized when customers obtain control of goods, which occurs at different points depending on the sales arrangement: (1) For domestic sales with customer pickup/acceptance, revenue is recognized upon customer inspection and acceptance; (2) For domestic sales with company delivery, revenue is recognized upon delivery to the agreed location and customer confirmation; (3) For export sales, revenue is recognized upon customs clearance and obtaining bills of lading or bonded warehouse receipts; (4) For contract manufacturing services, revenue is recognized upon customer inspection and acceptance. The company operates on a make-to-order basis with some buffer inventory.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading supplier in the light commercial refrigeration heat exchanger market with significant competitive advantages. The company's finned heat exchanger products hold a leading market share position in the light commercial refrigeration sector. Key competitive strengths include: (1) Over 20 years of industry experience and technical accumulation; (2) Established relationships with major OEM customers including Haier, Hisense, Midea, and Changan Automobile; (3) Comprehensive product portfolio covering multiple application scenarios; (4) Strong R&D and customization capabilities; (5) Quality control systems meeting international standards. The company competes in a fragmented market with numerous regional competitors but maintains leadership through technology and customer relationships.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company is a mid-sized manufacturer with significant growth trajectory. In 2023: revenue reached 980.07 million yuan (up 21.16% YoY), net profit attributable to parent company was 119.41 million yuan (up 41.63% YoY), and total assets reached 1.69 billion yuan (up 83.89% YoY). The company completed its IPO in May 2023, raising 560.16 million yuan in net proceeds. Key financial metrics show: gross margin of 23.91%, net margin of 12.18%, and ROE of 13.96%. The company has demonstrated consistent growth with revenue CAGR of approximately 11% from 2021-2023.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company's competitive differentiation is built on: (1) Customized design capabilities - offering over 2,000 finned heat exchanger variants tailored to specific customer applications and requirements; (2) Quality assurance - implementing rigorous quality control from design through production with FMEA analysis and statistical process control; (3) Flexible manufacturing - ability to rapidly switch between product types and accommodate multi-variety, small-batch production; (4) Technical expertise - deep knowledge of light commercial refrigeration system requirements accumulated over 20+ years; (5) Responsive service - 'three-heart' service philosophy emphasizing on-time delivery, quality assurance, and continuous innovation; (6) Broad application coverage - products serving diverse markets (smart retail, commercial kitchens, automotive, data centers, cold chain) reducing customer concentration risk; (7) Innovation focus - continuous product upgrades and new technology development aligned with industry trends like energy efficiency and environmental protection.
